fusions.name: Stripping the Field
fusions.desc: Bites into everything close, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Descending Cloud
fusions.desc: A bounding leap that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Famine Follows
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a devouring cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Marrow Meal
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
